description: The Korean won's nominal effective exchange rate rose to its highest level in about two years, data showed Monday. According to the Bank for International Settlements, the won's nominal effective exchange rate stood at 94.83 as of last Tuesday, compared with the previous month's 91.99. It marked the highest level since Oct. 9, 2024, when the NEER was 94.91.
